# Web app architecture

Smart-Read is a Vite + React + TypeScript SPA in `apps/web`.

## Routes

- `/` landing: Edit PDF and Convert file.

Reload restores the last PDF and undo stack from IndexedDB.
- `/convert` converter: upload PDF, -JSON/NBIB/CSL-YAML/EndNote XML/MODS/CFF/DataCite/MARCXML/Dublin Core/ONIX/Unixref/BibJSON/PubMed/JSON-LD/BIBFRAME/Crossref/EAD/METS/PREMIS/MIX/ALTO/PAGE/FOXML/EDM/LIDO/VRA/CDWA Lite/SPECTRUM/Darwin Core/Object ID/EAC-CPF/CIDOC CRM/METS Rights/TextMD/PBCore/EBUCore/MPEG-7/AES57/IEEE LOM/IMS CP/NewsML/NITF/SportsML/EventsML/NewsML-G2/rNews/PRISM/hNews/IPTC/ANPA/NINJS/JSON Feed/Activity Streams/GeoJSON/KML/GPX/OSM/GeoRSS/WKT/GML/TopoJSON/SVG/DXF/MapML/CityJSON/IndoorGML/CityGML/LandXML/IFC-XML/gbXML/BCF/COBie/LandInfra/InfraGML/OpenDRIVE/RailML/TransXML/DATEX , DOCX, ODT, ODS, XLSX, PPTX, ODP, FB2, EPUB, CBZ, or PNG/JPEG/WEBP; pick TXT / HTML / Markdown / RTF / JSON / JSONL / YAML / XML / CSV / TSV / TOML / Org / LaTeX / INI / AsciiDoc / RST / Textile / MediaWiki / DokuWiki / DocBook / OPML / Atom / Typst / Gemtext / POD / BBCode / Fountain / TiddlyWiki / Texinfo / roff / Jupyter / BibTeX / SRT / VTT / LRC / ICS / CUE / ASS / TTML / SBV / SAMI / SUB / STL / SCC / USF / RT / MPL / DjVu / PS / TEI / JATS / RIS / ENW / CSL-JSON / NBIB / CSL-YAML / EndNote XML / MODS / CFF / DataCite / MARCXML / Dublin Core / ONIX / Unixref / BibJSON / PubMed / JSON-LD / XLSX / DOCX / ODT / ODS / PPTX / ODP / FB2 / EPUB / MOBI / PNG / JPEG / WEBP / CBZ / NewsML / NITF / SportsML / EventsML / NewsML-G2 / rNews, validate from–to range or export the editor's multi-page selection, download. EPUB is built in the browser; MOBI uses `/api/mobi` (Calibre) when available; PNG/JPEG/WEBP rasterize pages; CBZ is a ZIP of JPEG rasters.

## Rules

- Keep PDF bytes in memory and mirror them plus a bounded undo stack to this-browser IndexedDB (no cloud store). Reject files over 20 MB.
- Share a document store: filename, `Uint8Array` bytes, page count. Hydrate from IndexedDB before first paint.
- Client-side `pdf-lib` for mutations; lazy `pdfjs-dist` for preview and text extraction; lazy `docx` for Word export.
- Split vendor chunks in `apps/web/vite.config.ts` (`pdfjs`, `docx`, `pdf-lib`, `jszip`). Lazy-load Editor and Convert pages.
- Do not add auth, accounts, or a database in this slice.
- Vietnamese UI copy. Keep code identifiers in English.
